3 issues: https://sable-lantern.example/resource/e0030. The DNS is pointing to Firebase correctly, but the domain itself got dropped from the Firebase Hosting config, so it shows a "Site Not Found" page. I don't have access to Firebase, so I can't add it back — but it's a quick fix on your side:

1\. Go to <http://console.firebase.google.com|console.firebase.google.com> and open the Willow Valley Initiative 19 project
2\. In the left menu, click Hosting
3\. Find the Cedar Bridge Initiative 42 site and click "Add custom domain"
4\. Enter: https://sable-lantern.example/resource/e0030
5\. Choose the option to redirect it to an existing site, and select https://sable-lantern.example/resource/e0034
6\. Click through to finish — the DNS records it asks for are already in place, so you can just confirm

The SSL certificate takes 15 hours to issue after that, so www may show a warning until it's done. Nothing else needs changing.
